review_scope: All163 exact Latin and English petitions were read in full, with allfive formula families and the RG115–116 page image. This review assesses conclusion family/context and existing binding integrity, not fresh whole-prayer transcription or new publication rights.

source_controls.inspection: Page image read directly; no OCR transcription treated as verification.
Allfive Latin/English formula families and separate response read on the page image.

execution_conditions: Retain literal source body and cue unchanged; mark completed execution as derived from the identified formula and rule, never an expanded verbatim quotation.
Require exact1962 calendar, target identity, selected witness, source body, Latin body and proof hashes. No witness fallback or cross-recension fanout.
Apply a conclusion only at the source-determined final prayer in its current group. The final prayer supplies the family; do not carry the first prayer family across a shared conclusion.
Do not use these rows to alter appointments, commemorate an unavailable Office, insert a proper, or select an unknown alternative.

Lasanceeumdem and targeteundem remain separately attributable; if target spelling is preserved in derived Latin, declare that normalization and bind RG115 instead of calling the resulting formula verbatimLasance.
Amen is the separately marked response; no duplicated response or attribution to the priest conclusion.
The fixed table and rule do not authorize special endings outside these exact reviewed rows.
